description: This file defines the HttpKernel class for the OrangeHRM installer framework, extending Symfony's BaseHttpKernel. It manages request handling, routing configuration, session setup, and logging within the installer module of the project.

classes.name: HttpKernel
classes.description: A custom HTTP kernel class extending Symfony's BaseHttpKernel, responsible for orchestrating request handling, route configuration, session management, and logging for the installer framework in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the HttpKernel with environment and debug settings, sets up dependency injection and services.

methods.name: configureContainer
methods.description: Registers core services in the service container used by the kernel.

methods.name: configureLogger
methods.description: Sets up the logging mechanism, determines log file writability, and registers log handlers.

methods.name: isLogFileWritable
methods.description: Checks whether the log file path is writable by attempting to append an empty string.

methods.name: configureRouter
methods.description: Sets up routing using YAML configuration and registers the router listener.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Loads route definitions from a YAML file into a RouteCollection.

methods.name: configureSession
methods.description: Configures session storage, checking directory permissions, and starts the session.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates and configures a session object with appropriate options and storage handler.

methods.name: configureSubscribers
methods.description: Adds event subscribers such as exception handling.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Prepares the environment and delegates the actual request handling to parent::handle.

methods.name: getEnvironment
methods.description: Returns the environment string, e.g., 'prod' or 'dev'.

methods.name: isDebug
methods.description: Returns whether debug mode is enabled.
